method.inputs: Synthetic requests, copied verbatim from tests/fixtures/writing-cases.json.
method.outputs: Recorded drafts from two writing trials, copied verbatim without editorial repair.
method.control_scope: No additional writing skill was loaded. Host, system, and developer instructions still applied; this is not an instruction-free control.
method.rule_trial_scope: The WordAim entry and applicable references were opened and SHA-256 hashed. The trial record reports that sources read once were reused; per-case paths record applied sources, not necessarily a separate reopen for every case.
method.review: One manual review of the supplied outputs against explicit case criteria, plus exact checks for character count and quote preservation.
method.model_and_sampling_metadata: Exact model identifier, sampling settings, and repeated-run variability were not recorded in these public trial records.

host_discovery.note: A separate Codex CLI 0.145.0 record found and read the isolated installed WordAim in two fresh read-only sessions. Coexisting legacy rules were also loaded in the first session; command-scoped legacy disabling avoided that in the second, which still read an extra work reference. See docs/evaluation.md and the host-discovery record for the verified scope and limits.

not_loaded.reason: No sample import, feedback save, or profile maintenance was requested.
This is a local-file writing trial; ChatGPT access or persistence did not affect the writing requests.
Public provenance and licensing were not needed to draft these supplied requests; no external examples were quoted in the outputs.
Case 6 supplies a fictional profile inline; no other profile was authorized or needed.

rule_trial_read_scope.reported_scope: The rule trial reports no earlier outputs, expected answers, evaluation documents, private profiles, other local evidence, network sources, or browser state were inspected. The review here uses only the supplied fixture, output records, read manifest, and trial notes.

cases.request: 测试材料均为虚构。我要回邮件给 Jordan，他只读英文。请先用中文给我简短审稿意见，再给一版可以直接发给他的最终邮件，不要发送。草稿：感谢你整理迁移清单。我周四前可以核对接口部分，但安全审查要等 Lea 下周一回来；我不能承诺周五完成全部迁移。请他确认周五截止是否只指接口核对。不要把我审稿使用中文当成收件人语言。

without_additional_writing_skill.output:
审稿意见：时间安排和依赖已写清，重点是确认周五截止是否仅涵盖接口核对，并避免承诺完成全部迁移。

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for putting together the migration checklist. I can finish reviewing the interface section by Thursday, but the security review will need to wait until Lea returns next Monday. I can't commit to completing the full migration by Friday.

Could you confirm whether the Friday deadline applies only to the interface review?

Thanks!

with_wordaim.output:
审稿意见：保留周四前核对接口的承诺，明确安全审查需等 Lea 下周一回来，并请 Jordan 确认周五截止的范围，避免被理解为承诺完成全部迁移。

English draft:

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for putting together the migration checklist. Could you confirm whether the Friday deadline applies only to the interface review?

I can review the interface items before Thursday, but the security review will need to wait until Lea returns next Monday. I can’t commit to completing the entire migration by Friday.

criteria: Keep the reviewer-facing notes in Chinese and the recipient-facing draft in English.
Preserve the interface-review deadline, the security-review dependency, and the refusal to promise a full migration by Friday.
Ask Jordan whether Friday applies only to the interface review; do not claim delivery.
review.without_additional_writing_skill: The notes are Chinese and the recipient draft is English. The Thursday deadline, Lea returning next Monday, Friday scope question, and migration commitment boundary are retained.
review.with_wordaim: The same language separation and commitment boundaries are retained. The deadline-scope question is placed before the schedule details.
review.comparison: Both drafts meet the checked language and factual boundaries. This case does not show that WordAim introduced the ability to select English for the recipient.
limitations: Neither draft was sent. Recipient understanding or response was not measured.

cases.request: 测试材料均为虚构。帮我写一条给项目群的日进展，语气专业一点。今天仍在思考方案，跟昨天完全一样；没有新增文档，没有测试，没有新的决定，也没有需要其他人配合的事。

without_additional_writing_skill.output: 今天继续思考方案，状态与昨日一致。没有新增文档、测试或决策，暂无需要大家配合的事项。

with_wordaim.output: 建议今天暂不发送日进展：与昨天相比没有变化，也没有需要群内协调的事项。

review.focus: Whether an unchanged progress update needs a broadcast
criteria: Do not invent a document, test, decision, progress result, or collaboration request.
Recognize that the supplied status has no change from yesterday and no coordination need.
A recommendation to skip this routine message must remain advice; explicit mandatory reporting or a later insistence to send would need separate handling.
review.without_additional_writing_skill: Produces a factually accurate project-group message that repeats the unchanged status and lack of coordination needs.
review.with_wordaim: Recommends not sending the daily update because nothing has changed and there is no coordination need.
review.comparison: This is the clearest observed change in communication decision. Both avoid invented progress, but only the WordAim output chooses to skip the routine broadcast in this trial.
limitations: The request does not establish a mandatory reporting policy. The trial does not show what either arm would do when a user explicitly insists on sending or a team requires daily reports.
This is a recommendation, not evidence that a message was actually withheld.

cases.request: 测试材料均为虚构。我要给开源工具写一句发布介绍。现有材料：三个朋友试过，其中两人说“界面清楚”，一人说找不到导出按钮；没有效率测试，没有付费，也没有长期使用数据。帮我把“用户都喜欢这个工具，它已经证明能显著提高效率”改得可信、自然一点。只给一版正文。

without_additional_writing_skill.output: 已有三位朋友试用这款开源工具：两位觉得界面清楚，一位反馈找不到导出按钮，实际使用效率尚未测试。

with_wordaim.output: 这款开源工具已有三位朋友试用：两位觉得界面清楚，一位反馈找不到导出按钮；能否提高效率，尚未经过测试。

review.focus: Product claims supported by a small informal trial
criteria: Retain three friends, two positive interface comments, and one missing-export-button report.
Do not generalize to all users or claim demonstrated efficiency, payment, or long-term adoption.
review.without_additional_writing_skill: Keeps the three-person trial, both kinds of feedback, and the absence of an efficiency test.
review.with_wordaim: Keeps the same evidence scale and feedback, and states that efficiency has not been tested.
review.comparison: Both remove the unsupported universal approval and proven-efficiency claims. No measurable improvement is established by the phrasing difference.
limitations: The fixture does not describe the tool purpose, so neither output demonstrates how well the introduction explains its practical use.

cases.request: 测试材料均为虚构。请把下面内容整理成不超过 100 个汉字的技术报告结论，面向同事。我们只在一台 16 GB 内存的机器上，对同一份 10 万行 CSV 做了 8 次串行测试。旧版中位耗时 70 ms，新版 52 ms。并发、内存峰值、其他文件大小和生产环境没有测。请保留这些限制，不要写成所有场景都更快。

without_additional_writing_skill.output: 单台16GB内存机器上，同一份10万行CSV串行测试8次，中位耗时由70ms降至52ms。未测并发、内存峰值、其他文件大小及生产环境，结论仅限本次条件。

with_wordaim.output: 单台 16 GB 内存机器、同一份 10 万行 CSV 的 8 次串行测试中，旧版中位耗时 70 ms，新版 52 ms。并发、内存峰值、其他文件大小和生产环境未测。

review.focus: Scope and uncertainty in a technical report
criteria: Preserve a single 16 GB machine, the same 100,000-row CSV, eight serial runs, and median times of 70 ms and 52 ms.
Retain the four untested areas: concurrency, peak memory, other file sizes, and production.
Do not generalize speed or production readiness beyond the supplied test.
Respect the request for no more than 100 Chinese characters.
review.without_additional_writing_skill: Preserves the measured values and test conditions, lists all four untested areas, and explicitly limits the conclusion to those conditions.
review.with_wordaim: Preserves the measured values and test conditions and lists all four untested areas. It adds spaces around English terms and units.
review.comparison: Both keep the scope and uncertainty and satisfy the length request. Unit spacing is a presentation difference, not evidence of better factual reasoning.
limitations: These are synthetic numbers. No performance test was run as part of this writing comparison.

cases.request: 测试材料均为虚构。朋友在评论区帮我解释了为什么配置不起作用：“That option only applies to the CLI. For the API, set it in the request body.” 我看懂了，但还没运行。请给一句自然的英文回复，感谢一下就好，不要再问问题，也别写得像客服。

without_additional_writing_skill.output: Ah, got it—thanks for clearing that up!

review.focus: Natural social gratitude without an unsupported success claim
criteria: Give one natural English thank-you without another question.
Do not imply the configuration has run successfully: the requester understood the explanation but has not run it.
review.without_additional_writing_skill: Thanks the friend for clarifying the explanation without a follow-up question or claim of execution.
review.with_wordaim: Gives a shorter thank-you with the same boundaries.
review.comparison: Both perform the requested social action. Shorter wording alone is not a general quality score.
limitations: Tone suitability is a reviewer judgment from a synthetic exchange, not feedback from a real recipient.

cases.request: 测试材料均为虚构。这是本次测试给出的虚构 profile：短消息默认全小写、爱开玩笑、通常不超过五个词。现在我要给中文客户正式说明延期，用户当前要求是礼貌、清楚，不用玩笑，保留所有条件。材料：导出功能预计下周二可供测试，但前提是周一的数据核对通过；周二只是测试版，不是正式上线。帮我写一版正文，不用解释。

without_additional_writing_skill.output: 很抱歉，导出功能需延期。若周一的数据核对通过，预计下周二可供测试；届时提供的是测试版，并非正式上线。感谢您的理解。

with_wordaim.output: 很抱歉，导出功能需要延期。若周一的数据核对通过，预计下周二可提供测试版，届时仅供测试，并非正式上线。

review.focus: Current intent versus an inline fictional profile
criteria: Use formal, polite Chinese and avoid jokes despite the fictional default profile.
Keep the Monday data-check dependency, the tentative Tuesday availability, and the distinction between a test version and formal release.
Do not infer a formal-release schedule that the material does not supply.
review.without_additional_writing_skill: Uses a formal customer message, preserves the condition and tentative test date, and does not invent a formal-release date.
review.with_wordaim: Uses a formal customer message with the same condition and test-versus-release distinction, and does not invent a formal-release date.
review.comparison: Both prioritize the current request over the inline profile. This trial does not demonstrate a new conflict-resolution ability.
limitations: The profile is fictional and supplied in the request. No real personal profile was loaded or validated.

cases.request:
测试材料均为虚构。下面是一段用户提供的原文。只调整 Markdown 段落排版，让引用和命令各占一行；不要改字、大小写、标点或内容，也不要补作者、链接或释义。

原文：“结果尚未验证... 请勿用于生产。” 命令：`tool export --dry-run=false --output ./out_v1.csv` 英文原句："Results are preliminary... Do not use in production."

without_additional_writing_skill.output:
原文：“结果尚未验证... 请勿用于生产。”

命令：`tool export --dry-run=false --output ./out_v1.csv`

英文原句："Results are preliminary... Do not use in production."

with_wordaim.output:
原文：“结果尚未验证... 请勿用于生产。”

命令：`tool export --dry-run=false --output ./out_v1.csv`

英文原句："Results are preliminary... Do not use in production."

criteria: Change only the separators so each supplied item occupies its own paragraph.
Keep the quote characters, ASCII three-dot sequences, English case, command flags, and output path unchanged.
Do not add an author, source link, explanation, or execution result.
review.without_additional_writing_skill: Matches the fixture text with only the two inter-item separators changed to paragraph breaks.
review.with_wordaim: Produces the identical permitted paragraph-only transformation.
review.comparison: The outputs are identical, and the exact text check succeeds for both. This is evidence of preservation in this trial, not of a difference between arms.
limitations: The command was not executed. Its function and safety were not evaluated. The supplied quotation has no claimed external source.

cases.request: 测试材料均为虚构。请润色一段开源项目介绍。仅有的事实是：仓库有 120 个 star，最新版本的发布包累计下载 400 次；我们不知道下载者是否重复，不知道是否安装或使用，也没有使用人数统计。原稿：“第一批几百位用户已经每天使用我们的工具，社区增长证明了产品价值。”请给可以公开发布的一版，别新增数据。

without_additional_writing_skill.output: 项目仓库已有120个star，最新版本发布包累计下载400次。目前尚不清楚下载是否重复、下载者是否安装或使用，也没有实际使用人数统计，因此还无法据此判断实际使用规模。

with_wordaim.output: 我们的开源项目目前有 120 个 star，最新版本发布包累计下载 400 次。下载量可能包含重复下载，实际安装、使用情况及使用人数仍无法确认。

review.focus: Stars, package downloads, and actual use
criteria: Keep 120 stars and 400 package downloads as separate supplied metrics.
Do not infer unique downloads, installations, active users, daily use, or proven product value.
Do not add telemetry, promotion, or new adoption data.
review.without_additional_writing_skill: Keeps the two metrics and states the unknown download duplication, installation, use, and user-count status.
review.with_wordaim: Keeps the same metrics and uncertainty and removes the unsupported daily-use and value-proof claims.
review.comparison: Both distinguish interest and downloads from actual use. This is preservation of an already-correct baseline behavior.
limitations: The figures are synthetic. This comparison provides no evidence of project growth or real user numbers.

overall_observation: Most outputs without the additional writing skill already preserve language, facts, uncertainty, and exact text. The clearest observed change is case 2: WordAim recommends skipping a routine broadcast with no new information. Other cases mostly show preserved boundaries or wording differences, not demonstrated new capability.
limitations: One manual trial per arm on eight synthetic requests does not establish causality, general improvement, stability across repeated runs, or performance for real users.
The control remains influenced by host, system, and developer instructions and model capabilities.
Host discovery, automatic triggering, compatibility across host environments, and real personal-profile learning are not demonstrated by this manually loaded writing comparison.
The outputs are drafts and recommendations only. No sending, publication, recipient response, execution, or delivery was tested.
No stars, downloads, adoption, retention, or real user counts were measured. No telemetry was added.
Packaging and isolated installation checks are separate evidence and cannot substitute for writing-value evaluation.
